question: How many customers bought more than once, and do they spend more?
sql:
WITH per_customer AS (
  SELECT
    oi.user_id,
    COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS orders,
    SUM(oi.sale_price) AS spend
  FROM s_order_items AS oi
  JOIN s_orders AS o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
  WHERE o.status NOT IN ('Cancelled', 'Returned')
  GROUP BY oi.user_id
)
SELECT
  IF(orders > 1, 'repeat', 'one-off') AS segment,
  COUNT(*) AS customers,
  ROUND(AVG(spend), 2) AS avg_spend,
  ROUND(SUM(spend), 2) AS total_spend
FROM per_customer
GROUP BY segment
LIMIT 10
report: Buyers split into repeat and one-off with average and total spend for each. Aggregating per customer first is what makes the averages mean anything; done in one pass the order rows would dominate.
